evidence.text: 2.1. Multi-Scale Linear Attention
EfficientViT: Multi-Scale Linear Attention for High-Resolution Dense Prediction

Figure 2: EfficientViT’s Building Block (left) and Multi-Scale Linear Attention (right). Left: EfficientViT’s building
block consists of a multi-scale linear attention module and an FFN with depthwise convolution (FFN+DWConv). Multi-
scale linear attention is responsible for capturing context information, while FFN+DWConv captures local information.
Right: After getting Q/K/V tokens via the linear projection layer, we generate multi-scale tokens by aggregating nearby
tokens via lightweight small-kernel convolutions. ReLU linear attention is applied to multi-scale tokens, and the outputs are
concatenated and fed to the final linear projection layer for feature fusing.
